results.name: 2025 Porsche Taycan Turbo GT Weissach Package
results.description:
Repositorio de modelos 3D de Ddiaz Design

![](https://media.drive.com.au/obj/tx_q:50,rs:auto:1920:1080:1/driveau/upload/cms/uploads/dirpxstlbtxvz9quczrl)

Porsche is expanding the model line-up of its all-electric sports sedan to include the Taycan Turbo GT and the Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach package. The latter is built for the track and dispenses with the rear seats in favour of an even better power-to-weight ratio. At peak power, both models can deliver more than 1,100 PS. In combination with various lightweight construction and aerodynamics measures, these all-electric GT sports cars raise the bar in terms of driving dynamics. A more powerful and efficient pulse inverter that uses silicon carbide as the semiconductor material is used on the rear axle.

results.description:
# Buy [Here](https://payhip.com/b/WH2uK)
The 2022 Porsche Taycan GTS is an electric sports car that combines cutting-edge technology with iconic Porsche performance. It features a dual-motor setup, delivering an impressive 509 horsepower and 626 lb-ft of torque, allowing the Taycan GTS to accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in just 3.5 seconds. The vehicle offers a range of up to 246 miles on a full charge.

Key features include adaptive air suspension, Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM), and a dynamic chassis control system for exceptional handling. The exterior design is sleek and aerodynamic, with LED matrix headlights, black accents, and 21-inch alloy wheels.

Inside, the Taycan GTS boasts a luxurious cabin with premium leather upholstery, a 16.8-inch curved digital instrument cluster, and a 10.9-inch touchscreen infotainment system. Additional features include Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and a 14-speaker Bose sound system.
